peopleIntro: Add people and select their existing latitude and longitude states. Add more people with the plus button.
peopleHelp: The unique ID is used in the object tree and should contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores. The optional output state receives the travel time to home in minutes in addition to the HomeRadar object tree.
placesIntro: Add any number of places. The radius determines when a person is considered present at a place.
placesHelp: Mark exactly one place as home. Presence detection is calculated locally from coordinates and does not need a routing service.
routingIntro: Travel-time calculation is optional. Presence and place detection continue to work without a routing service.
routingHelp: By default, the public OSRM demo service is used without live traffic. If it fails, OpenRouteService can be used as a fallback. Create a free account at openrouteservice.org, copy the Basic Key from the API Key tab of the dashboard, and enter it here. The free plan currently allows 2,000 directions requests per day and 40 per minute. Requests are rate limited.
helpIntro: HomeRadar reads the selected coordinate states and creates per-person states for presence, detected place, distances, and optional travel times.
helpPrivacy: Presence calculations stay local. When route calculation is enabled, origin and destination coordinates are sent to OSRM; if that service fails and the fallback is enabled, they are also sent to OpenRouteService. When a person is within the destination radius, travel time is set to 0 minutes locally.
